intent: Issue 967: standalone Errands (requests) with check/expiry/key, an hourly errands loop with a still-needed look, long_wait only past due, a 72h final screen of held signals, Console Back at desk, and the since band 'Errands closed without you'.

findings.message: readAsks selects every open Errand that reached the owner, now including standalone ones with issue_id NULL, and calls issueNumberOf(w.issue_id), which does null.slice and throws.
findings.failureScenario: POST /v1/errands/requests stores an Errand with issue_id NULL and reached_owner_at set; the next overview or asks read (read/reader.ts:82, :166) throws a TypeError instead of listing it, so the read surfaces break while any request is open.
findings.fix: Make readAsks null-safe for issue_id (issue null, issueRef null, repo null, visible false), or filter standalone errands out of this read, and add a test with an open request.

findings.message: The check is wrapped as `(${command}) 2>&1`, so a trailing `# comment` swallows the closing paren; sh exits 2 with a syntax error, and checkVerdict maps 1..125 to not_needed.
findings.failureScenario: A request posted with check `test -f /tmp/seal # sealed` is closed as no longer needed by the next hourly errands pass although the check never ran, which contradicts the documented rule that a check that could not answer never closes the request.
findings.fix: Put a newline before the closing paren (`(${command}\n) 2>&1`), or pass the command to sh -c unwrapped and merge stderr via the spawn options; consider treating sh's exit 2 as unrunnable.

findings.message: The change registers a new loop `errands` (main.ts, between digest and reaper) but this scenario test still asserts the exact list of sixteen loop names.
findings.failureScenario: The scenarios suite runs the real main.ts; GET /v1/loops now returns 17 names, so the toEqual at line 58 fails.
findings.fix: Add 'errands' between 'digest' and 'reaper' in the expected list and update the 'sixteen' wording.

checked: errands.issue_id nullable: every reader of factory.errands traced. needs.ts uses a LEFT JOIN and is fine; kpis-flow.ts and recheckCandidates are filtered; unscreenedErrands is gated by reached_owner_at; read/asks.ts:39 is NOT null-safe (finding 1)

LOOP_NAMES 'errands': written at packages/contract/src/loops.ts:317, registered at main.ts:562, settings at settings.ts, env allow-list at scripts/env-file.sh; the loops scenario test at tests/scenarios/loops/loops.test.ts:58 was not updated (finding 3)

check command execution: runProcess childEnv strips secrets (adapters/quality/process.ts:31), group kill and timeout work, and policy.ts:74 allows owner, orchestrator and agent only; the wrapper's syntax-error path is finding 2
closed_by/closed_kind: written by finishErrand, supersedeRequests and turnAwayErrand in checkpoint-store.ts; read by read/since.ts:2193 (band) and api/checkpoints.ts errandView
final screen: screenable SQL (intake/store.ts) and isFinalScreen agree; promote passes the steer into a noted event (app/intake.ts:1254)
requestErrand replay and supersede flow: errandByKey, supersedeRequests and the open-key unique index agree; the owner-closed-while-check-ran race is guarded by done_at IS NULL
migration 1015: number is unique (1014 was the latest), the ALTERs are additive, and the one UPDATE is bounded to turned_away rows
the agw workflow factory-errand-needed is defined outside this repo (unverified)

criteria.item: Standalone Errands (requests) with command, host, check, expiry and key, via `factory errand request` and POST /v1/errands/requests
Hourly errands loop runs checks (exit 1..125 closes, a check that cannot answer keeps it) and closes expired requests

long_wait appears in Needs only once its timer is past due
A held signal 72 h old gets a final screening that promotes with a steer or dismisses
